story.text: 토요일 오후, 우리는 조용한 골목 안 작은 카페에 마주 앉았다. 평소라면 먼저 농담을 던졌을 그가, 오늘은 이상하게 말이 없었다.
story.reading: to-yo-il o-hu, u-ri-neun jo-yong-han gol-mok an jak-eun ka-pe-e ma-ju anj-at-da. pyeong-so-ra-myeon meon-jeo nong-dam-eul deon-jyeot-eul geu-ga, o-neul-eun i-sang-ha-ge mal-i eop-seot-da.
story.en: Saturday afternoon, we sat facing each other in a small cafe tucked in a quiet alley. He, who would normally crack a joke first, was strangely quiet today.

story.text: 몇 번이나 입을 열려다 마는 그의 모습이, 조금 어색해 보였다. 나는 그 모습이 낯설면서도 신기했다.
story.reading: myeot beon-i-na ib-eul yeol-lyeo-da ma-neun geu-ui mo-seub-i, jo-geum eo-saek-hae bo-yeot-da. na-neun geu mo-seub-i nat-seol-myeon-seo-do sin-gi-haet-da.
story.en: The way he kept starting to speak and stopping looked a little awkward. I found it both unfamiliar and fascinating.

story.text: 그는 커피잔을 만지작거리다가 겨우 입을 열었다. '저 지금 완전 긴장했어요. 믿겨요? 능글맞은 규현 기장이 이런 것도 다 있네요.'
story.reading: geu-neun keo-pi-jan-eul man-ji-jak-geo-ri-da-ga gyeo-u ib-eul yeol-eot-da. jeo ji-geum wan-jeon gin-jang-haet-seo-yo. mid-gyeo-yo? neung-geul-maj-eun gyu-hyeon gi-jang-i i-reon geot-do da it-ne-yo.
story.en: He fidgeted with his coffee cup and finally spoke. "I'm completely nervous right now. Can you believe it? Turns out even smooth Captain Kyuhyun has moments like this."

story.text: '사실 저, 이런 자리 진짜 오랜만이에요. 아니, 어쩌면 처음일지도 몰라요 — 이렇게 서툴게 구는 거.'
story.reading: sa-sil jeo, i-reon ja-ri jin-jja o-raen-man-i-e-yo. a-ni, eo-jjeo-myeon cheo-eum-il-ji-do mol-la-yo — i-reo-ke seo-tul-ge gu-neun geo.
story.en: "Honestly, it's been a really long time since I've been on a date like this. Or, maybe this is actually the first time — being this clumsy about it."

story.text: 다들 그를 바람둥이라고 불렀지만, 정작 마주 앉은 그는 자기 속마음을 꺼내는 데 서툰 사람이었다. 소문과 실제 모습이 이렇게 다를 줄은 몰랐다.
story.reading: da-deul geu-reul ba-ram-dung-i-ra-go bul-leot-ji-man, jeong-jak ma-ju anj-eun geu-neun ja-gi sok-ma-eum-eul kkeo-nae-neun de seo-tun sa-ram-i-eot-da. so-mun-gwa sil-je mo-seub-i i-reo-ke da-reul jul-eun mol-lat-da.
story.en: Everyone called him a player, but sitting across from him now, he was actually someone clumsy at revealing his inner feelings. I hadn't expected the rumors to be so different from reality.

story.text: 그는 겸연쩍게 웃으며 말했다. '근데 이상하게, 아가씨 앞에서는 어색한 것도 나쁘지 않네요. 오히려… 편안해요.'
story.reading: geu-neun gyeom-yeon-jjeok-ge us-eu-myeo mal-haet-da. geun-de i-sang-ha-ge, a-ga-ssi ap-e-seo-neun eo-saek-han geot-do na-ppeu-ji an-ne-yo. o-hi-ryeo… pyeon-an-hae-yo.
story.en: He laughed sheepishly. "But strangely, even being awkward doesn't feel so bad in front of you. If anything... I feel comfortable."

story.text: 완벽하게 능글맞던 사람이 보여준 서투른 진심이, 그 어떤 매끄러운 농담보다 더 깊이 와닿았다.
story.reading: wan-byeok-ha-ge neung-geul-maj-deon sa-ram-i bo-yeo-jun seo-tu-reun jin-sim-i, geu eo-tteon mae-kkeu-reo-un nong-dam-bo-da deo gip-i wa-da-at-da.
story.en: The clumsy sincerity shown by someone who was normally flawlessly smooth touched me far more deeply than any of his polished jokes ever had.

words.example_en: It was a little awkward when we first met.
He's clumsy at this kind of conversation.
I feel at ease when I'm beside him.
He finally showed his true feelings.

words.example: 그는 나 때문에 긴장한 것 같았다.
words.example_reading: geu-neun na ttae-mun-e gin-jang-han geot gat-at-da
words.example_en: He seemed nervous because of me.
